### Building values
# Construction times
@merchant_company_main_construction_time_02 = 365
@merchant_company_main_construction_time_03 = 545
@merchant_company_main_construction_time_04 = 730
@merchant_company_main_construction_time_05 = 915
@merchant_company_main_construction_time_06 = 1100
@merchant_company_building_construction_time = 365
@merchant_company_external_construction_time_02 = 120
@merchant_company_external_construction_time_03 = 240
@merchant_company_external_construction_time_04 = 360
@merchant_company_external_construction_time_05 = 480
@merchant_company_external_construction_time_06 = 600
@merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_01 = 90
@merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_02 = 120
@merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_03 = 150
@merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_04 = 180
@merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_05 = 210
@merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_06 = 240

# Value scale for internal buildings: one level is roughly one of these, halved when combined with another strong modifier
# _mid and _cheap prices are for goods with a base price of at most 0.18 and 0.12, where a flat percentage earns little gold
@company_capacity_add = 3
@company_capacity_add_combo = 1
@company_capacity_mult = 0.02
@company_sell_price_all = 0.005
@company_sell_price_all_half = 0.0025
@company_buy_price_all = -0.005
@company_sell_price_category = 0.0025
@company_buy_price_category = -0.0025
@company_buy_price_category_half = -0.00125
@company_buy_price_all_half = -0.0025
@company_sell_price_renown = 0.005
@company_buy_price_renown = -0.005
@company_sell_price_renown_mid = 0.0075
@company_buy_price_renown_mid = -0.0075
@company_sell_price_renown_cheap = 0.01
@company_buy_price_renown_cheap = -0.01
@company_sell_price_category_mid = 0.00375
@company_buy_price_category_mid = -0.00375
@company_sell_price_category_cheap = 0.005
@company_buy_price_category_cheap = -0.005
@company_prestige_standalone_minor = 0.01
@company_prestige_standalone = 0.02

# Main Building (Townhouse to Palace)
merchant_company_main_01 = {
	allowed_domicile_types = { merchant_company }
	slot_type = main
	internal_slots = 3
	construction_time = 1

	character_modifier = {
		domicile_external_slots_capacity_add = 4
		domicile_monthly_gold_add = 0.5
		negate_health_penalty_add = 0.6
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_main_upgrade_value
	}

	asset = {
		trigger = {
			company_domicile_western_asset_trigger = yes
		}
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/domicile_building/domicile_building_merchant_western_villa.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_villa_western.dds"
		intersectionmask_texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_villa_western_mask.png"
		soundeffect = "event:/DLC/EP3/SFX/UI/domicile_buildings/ep3_ui_domicile_buildings_estate_main_building"
	}

	asset = {
		trigger = {
			company_domicile_asian_asset_trigger = yes
		}
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/domicile_building/domicile_building_merchant_asian_villa.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_villa_asian.dds"
		intersectionmask_texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_villa_asian_mask.png"
		soundeffect = "event:/DLC/EP3/SFX/UI/domicile_buildings/ep3_ui_domicile_buildings_estate_main_building"
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/domicile_building/domicile_building_merchant_mena_villa.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_villa_mena.dds"

merchant_company_main_02 = {
	allowed_domicile_types = { merchant_company }
	slot_type = main
	internal_slots = 4
	previous_building = merchant_company_main_01
	construction_time = @merchant_company_main_construction_time_02

	cost = {
		prestige = {
			if = {
				limit = { government_has_flag = government_is_merchant }
				value = merchant_company_main_prestige_cost_tier_2_value
			}
			else = { value = 0 }
		}
		gold = merchant_company_main_cost_tier_2_value

# Mineral Stalls (Internal Building)

merchant_company_mineral_stalls_01 = {
	allowed_domicile_types = { merchant_company }
	slot_type = internal
	previous_building = merchant_company_building_trade_01
	construction_time = @merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_01

	cost = {
		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_1_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_category_precious_metals_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
		trade_category_base_metals_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
		trade_category_jewelry_materials_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
		trade_category_salt_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_normal_new_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					scope:owner ?= {
						merchant_company_ai_trades_any_category_trigger = {
							CAT1 = trade_category_precious_metals
							CAT2 = trade_category_base_metals
							CAT3 = trade_category_jewelry_materials
							CAT4 = trade_category_salt
						}
					}
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_off_trade_branch_internal_value
		}
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/domicile_building/domicile_trade_expertise_minerals.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western.dds"
		intersectionmask_texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western_mask.png"

		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_1_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_category_clothes_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
		trade_category_alum_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
		trade_category_dyes_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
		trade_category_luxury_items_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_normal_new_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					scope:owner ?= {
						merchant_company_ai_trades_any_category_trigger = {
							CAT1 = trade_category_clothes
							CAT2 = trade_category_alum
							CAT3 = trade_category_dyes
							CAT4 = trade_category_luxury_items
						}
					}
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_off_trade_branch_internal_value
		}
	}

			}
		}
	}

		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_6_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_category_dyes_xp_gain_mult = 0.10
		trade_category_dyes_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_category
		trade_category_clothes_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
		trade_category_alum_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
		trade_category_luxury_items_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_normal_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					scope:owner ?= {
						merchant_company_ai_trades_category_trigger = { CATEGORY = trade_category_dyes }
					}
				}

			value = merchant_company_ai_off_trade_branch_internal_value
		}

	allowed_domicile_types = { merchant_company }
	slot_type = internal
	previous_building = merchant_company_building_trade_01
	construction_time = @merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_01

	cost = {
		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_1_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_category_luxury_consumption_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
		trade_category_incense_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
		trade_category_books_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
		trade_category_medicaments_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_normal_new_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					scope:owner ?= {
						merchant_company_ai_trades_any_category_trigger = {
							CAT1 = trade_category_luxury_consumption
							CAT2 = trade_category_incense
							CAT3 = trade_category_books
							CAT4 = trade_category_medicaments
						}
					}
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_off_trade_branch_internal_value
		}
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/domicile_building/domicile_trade_expertise_luxuries.dds"

		# MB Added End

		trade_good_jade_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_category
		trade_good_jade_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_category

							CATEGORY = trade_category_jewelry_materials

							CATEGORY = trade_category_jewelry_materials
							GOOD = trade_good_jade

	cost = {
		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_6_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_good_amber_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_category
		# MB Added
		trade_good_pearls_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_category
		# MB Added End
		trade_good_amber_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_category
		trade_good_ivory_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_category
		trade_good_ivory_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_category
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_avoided_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner ?= {
					OR = {
						merchant_company_ai_trades_good_trigger = {
							CATEGORY = trade_category_jewelry_materials
							GOOD = trade_good_amber
						}
						merchant_company_ai_trades_good_trigger = {
							CATEGORY = trade_category_jewelry_materials
							GOOD = trade_good_ivory
						}
					}
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_preferred_internal_value
		}
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_types/resource_buildings/amber_buildings.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western.dds"
		intersectionmask_texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western_mask.png"
	}

				has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_trade_06_competition
				has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_trade_06_revenue
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_6_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_category_dyes_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_category
		trade_category_dyes_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_category
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_avoided_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner ?= {
					merchant_company_ai_trades_category_trigger = { CATEGORY = trade_category_dyes }
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_preferred_internal_value
		}
	}

	slot_type = internal
	previous_building = merchant_company_sugar_traders_04
	construction_time = @merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_05

	can_construct = {
		domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_trade_04 }
	}

	cost = {
		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_5_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_good_sugar_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_category
		trade_good_sugar_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_category
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_avoided_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner ?= {
					merchant_company_ai_trades_good_trigger = {
						CATEGORY = trade_category_luxury_consumption
						GOOD = trade_good_sugar
					}
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_preferred_internal_value
		}
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_types/resource_buildings/sugar_buildings.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western.dds"
		intersectionmask_texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western_mask.png"
	}
}

# Quayside Stores (Internal Building, coastal company location)
merchant_company_quayside_stores_01 = {
	allowed_domicile_types = { merchant_company }
	slot_type = internal
	previous_building = merchant_company_building_warehouse_01
	construction_time = @merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_01

	can_construct_potential = {
		domicile ?= {
			domicile_location.county ?= { is_coastal_county = yes }

	}

		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_3_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_category_cereals_xp_gain_mult = 0.10
		trade_category_cereals_xp_gain_add = 2
		trade_category_meat_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
		trade_category_comforts_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
		trade_category_alcohol_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_filler_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					scope:owner ?= {
						merchant_company_ai_trades_category_trigger = { CATEGORY = trade_category_cereals }
					}
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_off_trade_branch_internal_value

	construction_time = @merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_03

	can_construct = {
		domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_warehouse_03 }
	}

	cost = {
		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_3_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_category_stone_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_category_cheap
		trade_category_carpentry_supplies_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_category_cheap
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_avoided_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner ?= {
					OR = {
						merchant_company_ai_trades_category_trigger = { CATEGORY = trade_category_carpentry_supplies }
						merchant_company_ai_trades_category_trigger = { CATEGORY = trade_category_stone }
					}
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_preferred_internal_value
		}
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/domicile_building/domicile_building_mason.dds"

		trade_category_base_metals_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_category
		trade_category_base_metals_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_category
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_avoided_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner ?= {
					merchant_company_ai_trades_category_trigger = { CATEGORY = trade_category_base_metals }
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_preferred_internal_value
		}
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_types/resource_buildings/iron_buildings.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western.dds"
		intersectionmask_texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western_mask.png"
	}
}

# Market Cross (Internal Building)
merchant_company_market_cross_01 = {
	allowed_domicile_types = { merchant_company }
	slot_type = internal
	previous_building = merchant_company_building_civic_01
	construction_time = @merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_01

	cost = {
		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_1_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_category_cereals_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_category_mid
		trade_category_cereals_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_category_mid
		trade_category_beasts_of_burden_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_category_mid
		trade_category_beasts_of_burden_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_category_mid
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_avoided_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner ?= {
					OR = {
						merchant_company_ai_trades_category_trigger = { CATEGORY = trade_category_beasts_of_burden }
						merchant_company_ai_trades_category_trigger = { CATEGORY = trade_category_cereals }
					}
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_preferred_new_internal_value
		}
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/domicile_building/domicile_tenant_farmer.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western.dds"
		intersectionmask_texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western_mask.png"
	}
}

# Credit Network (Internal Building, capstone reward)

	allowed_domicile_types = { merchant_company }
	slot_type = internal

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = merchant_company_creditor_capstone_01_tt

		suzerain_opinion = 15
		domicile_monthly_gold_add = 1
	}

# Clothworkers' Hall (Internal Building)
merchant_company_clothworkers_hall_01 = {
	allowed_domicile_types = { merchant_company }
	slot_type = internal
	previous_building = merchant_company_building_production_01
	construction_time = @merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_01

	cost = {
		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_1_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_category_fabrics_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_category
		trade_category_clothes_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_category
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_avoided_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner ?= {
					OR = {
						merchant_company_ai_trades_category_trigger = { CATEGORY = trade_category_clothes }
						merchant_company_ai_trades_category_trigger = { CATEGORY = trade_category_fabrics }
					}
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_preferred_new_internal_value
		}
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_types/resource_buildings/tailor_shops.dds"

# Fish Market (Internal Building, requires high expertise)
merchant_company_fish_market_01 = {
	allowed_domicile_types = { merchant_company }
	slot_type = internal
	previous_building = merchant_company_building_production_01
	construction_time = @merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_01

	can_construct = {
		gdp_renown_building_expertise_trigger = { CATEGORY = trade_category_meat }
	}

	cost = {
		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_1_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_good_fish_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_renown_mid
		trade_good_fish_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_renown_mid
		monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.01
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_avoided_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner ?= {
					merchant_company_ai_trades_good_trigger = {
						CATEGORY = trade_category_meat
						GOOD = trade_good_fish
					}
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_preferred_new_internal_value
		}
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_types/resource_buildings/fish_buildings.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western.dds"
		intersectionmask_texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western_mask.png"
	}
}

# Cheesemongers' Hall (Internal Building, requires high expertise)
merchant_company_cheesemongers_hall_01 = {
	allowed_domicile_types = { merchant_company }
	slot_type = internal
	previous_building = merchant_company_building_production_01
	construction_time = @merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_01

	can_construct = {
		gdp_renown_building_expertise_trigger = { CATEGORY = trade_category_comforts }
	}

	cost = {
		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_1_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_good_cheese_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_renown_mid
		trade_good_cheese_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_renown_mid
		character_travel_safety = 1
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_avoided_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner ?= {
					merchant_company_ai_trades_good_trigger = {
						CATEGORY = trade_category_comforts
						GOOD = trade_good_cheese
					}
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_preferred_new_internal_value
		}
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_types/resource_buildings/cheese_cave.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western.dds"
		intersectionmask_texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western_mask.png"

}

				has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_production_06_prestige
				has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_production_06_income
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_6_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_good_tea_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_renown_mid
		trade_good_tea_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_renown_mid
		stress_loss_mult = 0.01
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_avoided_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner ?= {
					merchant_company_ai_trades_good_trigger = {
						CATEGORY = trade_category_comforts
						GOOD = trade_good_tea
					}
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_preferred_internal_value
		}
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_types/resource_buildings/tea_buildings.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western.dds"

	construction_time = @merchant_company_upgrade_construction_time_06

	can_construct = {
		gdp_renown_building_expertise_trigger = { CATEGORY = trade_category_clothes }
		domicile ?= {
			OR = {
				has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_production_06_prestige
				has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_production_06_income
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_6_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_good_furs_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_renown
		trade_good_furs_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_renown
		monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.01
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_avoided_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner ?= {
					merchant_company_ai_trades_good_trigger = {
						CATEGORY = trade_category_clothes
						GOOD = trade_good_furs
					}
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_preferred_internal_value
		}
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_types/resource_buildings/furs_buildings.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western.dds"
		intersectionmask_texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western_mask.png"
	}
}

		domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = merchant_company_building_production_04 }
	}

	cost = {
		gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_5_value
	}

	character_modifier = {
		trade_good_textiles_sell_price_mult = @company_sell_price_renown
		trade_good_textiles_buy_price_mult = @company_buy_price_renown
		monthly_diplomacy_lifestyle_xp_gain_add = 1
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = merchant_company_ai_avoided_internal_value
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner ?= {
					merchant_company_ai_trades_good_trigger = {
						CATEGORY = trade_category_clothes
						GOOD = trade_good_textiles
					}
				}
			}
			value = merchant_company_ai_preferred_internal_value
		}
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_types/resource_buildings/textile_weavery.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western.dds"
		intersectionmask_texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/merchant_company_grand_estate_western_mask.png"
	}
}

# Company Workshop (Internal Building, capstone reward)
merchant_company_artisan_capstone_01 = {
	allowed_domicile_types = { merchant_company }
	slot_type = internal

	cost = { gold = merchant_company_upgrade_cost_tier_5_value }

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = merchant_company_artisan_capstone_01_tt
			exists = primary_title.var:merchant_company_artisan_capstone_unlocked
		}
	}

	character_modifier = {
		artifact_decay_reduction_mult = -0.35
		trade_good_jewelry_sell_price_mult = 0.075
		trade_good_glass_sell_price_mult = 0.075
		trade_good_ceramics_sell_price_mult = 0.075
		trade_good_lacquerware_sell_price_mult = 0.075
		trade_good_textiles_sell_price_mult = 0.075
		trade_good_books_paper_sell_price_mult = 0.075
		trade_category_precious_metals_buy_price_mult = -0.075
		trade_good_gems_buy_price_mult = -0.075
		trade_expertise_growth_mult = 0.5
		prestige_standalone_gain_mult = 0.1
	}
	
	parameters = {
		company_better_inspiration_quality = yes
		company_better_artifact_schemes = yes
	}
	
	ai_value = { value = merchant_company_ai_capstone_value }

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/domicile_building/artisan_capstone.dds"

	}
